mockPaymentSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the timestamp, idempotency key, complete callback intent, and exact evaluation context when present.

MerchantChangeRequest.description: Strict JSON, no duplicate or unknown fields, at most 65536 bytes. Never accepts owner, approval authority or a replacement snapshot.

MerchantListingChangePayload.description: Fields are title, short_description, long_description, category, supported supplemental attributes, or existing descriptive attribute names. Shared content on a variant must be edited on its family. Price, inventory, identities, option dimensions, tax, compliance, cost and quality bookkeeping are protected. At most 25 actual SKUs may be affected.

MerchantInventoryChangePayload.description: Restock applies to a leaf SKU. Pause and activate may expand a family into its real leaf SKUs. At most 25 stock/status field changes and 25 leaf SKUs; duplicate changes to the same field are rejected. No fabricated cartesian variants.

MerchantChange.description: Server-owned proposal and persisted terminal. PRICE_UPDATE uses the same draft IDs, snapshots and receipts as the existing price-draft API; its payload is null and items carry the price snapshot. Other kinds return the stored request plus structured before/after items. Result is null until terminal resolution.

productVersion.description: Historical standard-order version; null for seckill orders, which do not store this column.

reservedAmountMinor.description: Sum of requested amounts in REQUESTED, PROCESSING and SUCCEEDED; excludes FAILED. This is reserved refund capacity, not necessarily money refunded.

RetailSearch.description: Price filters and price sorting require currency. All attribute and price constraints must match one actual SKU. Request body limit 8192 bytes. Offset paginates plain/family roots, never individual variants; each page uses one repeatable-read snapshot. Separate requests may observe intervening catalog changes.

RetailProduct.description: Buyer projection with live product truth. Summaries omit variants and long detail fields; family publicationVersion is null.

snapshotId.description: Deterministic UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes identity derived from contentCommitment and watermark.

records.description: Complete records ordered by sourceId ascending and then chunkId ascending.

ownerTestUserLabel.description: Optional secondary test principal in the same sandbox that owns this order. Must differ from the reset testUserLabel.

paymentOrder.description: Optional server-controlled evaluation payment fixture bound to the primary test principal by default, or to the named secondary test principal, and one listed product.

paymentOrderOwnerTestUserHandle.description: Secondary payment-order owner's opaque handle, present only when ownerTestUserLabel was requested.

effects.description: Global ascending order by createdAt, then effectType, then the internal stable correlation key

payments.description: Global ascending order by createdAt, then attemptId.

state.description: UNFULFILLED is a terminal admitted reservation for which authoritative MySQL constraints could not create an order; it carries decisionCode ADMITTED, projectionVersion 3, durableOrderCreated false, and null orderId.

starts.description: ISO local date in Asia/Shanghai, or an offset timestamp. An ends date includes that calendar day; an ends timestamp is exclusive.

ends.description: ISO local date in Asia/Shanghai, or an offset timestamp. An ends date includes that calendar day; an ends timestamp is exclusive.

MerchantPromotionPayload.description: Expands actual family members to at most 25 unique SKUs; freezes half-up rounded integer minor prices. Approval inside the operating window changes the official product price. No automatic start or end-price restoration.

starts.description: ISO local date in Asia/Shanghai, or an offset timestamp. An ends date includes that calendar day; an ends timestamp is exclusive.

ends.description: ISO local date in Asia/Shanghai, or an offset timestamp. An ends date includes that calendar day; an ends timestamp is exclusive.

MerchantCampaignPayload.description: Creates or changes a local marketing plan. Omitted optional fields retain their previous value on update; null clears them. New plans use CNY and have no attributed spend/revenue. Cannot execute external advertising.

MerchantCampaign.description: Persisted local plan plus independent nullable observations. Changing a plan does not manufacture or alter attributed results. Compare revenue/spend only for their shared observed window; missing revenue is not zero.

MerchantPromotionTarget.description: The approved promotion price/currency is historical. Current price and currency remain authoritative product facts; overridden means the current price or currency differs, while currentVersion separately exposes later publication.

MerchantPromotion.description: Applied price change and its operating window. Ended does not mean the prior price was restored; restoration requires another explicit approval.

MerchantSalesWindow.description: Thirty complete Shanghai calendar days before asOf; paid-time interval is [start,end).

MerchantListingSales.description: Actual paid-order cohort. Refund count is distinct orders with valid refund requests, not physical returns. Historical amounts are queried separately by currency.

MerchantListing.description: Merchant catalog includes unavailable and unpublished products. Family aggregates all actual SKUs and is not directly tradeable. Unknown operating cost/quality/margin is null; there is no inferred price-change timestamp.

MerchantInventoryAlert.description: Low stock means stock <= known threshold. Slow mover means stock > known threshold and <= 5 units in the complete 30-day window. Cover is null with zero sales.
